title: 5-Minute Box Breathing Reset
description: A grounding pranayama technique: inhale for 4 counts, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4.
guide_steps: Find a comfortable upright posture with spine elongated.
Inhale slowly through your nose for 4 counts.
Gently hold your breath with relaxed shoulders for 4 counts.
Exhale smoothly through your mouth for 4 counts.
Hold empty and peaceful for 4 counts. Repeat for 5 cycles.

title: 10-Minute Mindful Awareness & Body Scan
description: Gradually bring mindful attention to sensations throughout your body from toes to crown.
guide_steps: Close your eyes and take three deep cleansing breaths.
Bring attention to the soles of your feet and calf muscles; notice warmth or tension and release it.
Move attention up through the abdomen, chest, shoulders, and jaw.
Acknowledge wandering thoughts like clouds drifting across the sky, gently returning to the breath.

title: Evening Stress Release & Gratitude Meditation
description: Decompress after work or study hours, letting go of daytime cognitive overload.
guide_steps: Sit back comfortably and soften your gaze.
Exhale long and slow, visualizing releasing the demands of the day.
Recall three simple moments from today that brought calm, appreciation, or satisfaction.
Rest in a sensation of quiet ease and contentment.

title: Deep Sleep Transition & Progressive Muscle Relaxation
description: Prepare your nervous system for deep restorative sleep by systematically releasing muscular tension.
guide_steps: Lie down in bed in your preferred sleeping posture.
Dim all lights and breathe at a steady, rhythmic cadence.
Tense your feet gently for 5 seconds, then consciously let them go completely limp.
Progress through thighs, abdomen, hands, shoulders, and facial muscles.
Sink into the mattress and welcome peaceful slumber.

title: 3-Minute Micro-Break Mindful Reset
description: A quick recharge between study sessions or computer tasks to relieve cognitive fatigue.
guide_steps: Look away from screens at a distant object or close your eyes.
Take 5 intentional slow breaths, dropping your shoulders on every exhale.
Roll your neck gently and open your eyes with refreshed focus.
